identity.description: I design and prototype physical-digital products that connect hardware, software, and human experience. I recently graduated from NYU's Integrated Design & Media program, where my work focused on E-Ink devices, embedded systems, AI tools, 3D printing, and interaction design.
identity.availability: Currently looking for product design, UX, creative technology, hardware prototyping, and early-stage product opportunities.
